description: TLS cipher suite grader — Grade a TLS cipher list offline. ciphers= takes an OpenSSL list (ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:...) or IANA names (TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_...), comma/colon/space separated; optional protocols= (e.g. TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3). Per suite: key exchange, authentication, cipher, MAC, AEAD, forward secrecy, OpenSSL/IANA name mapping and a rating (recommended/secure/weak/insecure: NULL, EXPORT, anonymous, RC4, DES, 3DES SWEET32, MD5, static RSA, CBC). Flags SSLv3/TLS1.0/1.1, missing TLS 1.3, weak suites ordered first and broad OpenSSL keywords (ALL, LOW, EXPORT, missing !aNULL). Returns grade A+ to F, PASS/REVIEW/FAIL, Mozilla profile (modern/intermediate/old) and a safer list. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_tls_ciphers
